question: According to Figure 4D-2, what are the general minimum and maximum longitudinal distances from the stop line for the primary signal faces, absent the near-side supplemental-face exception?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 4D-2 shows that primary signal faces must be located no less than 40 feet beyond the stop line and no more than 180 feet beyond the stop line (the 180-foot maximum applies to 12-inch signal faces and can only be exceeded if a supplemental near-side signal face is provided). The figure also shows a shorter maximum of 120 feet from the stop line for 8-inch signal faces. Standards (mandatory): - Primary signal faces "shall be located: 1. No less than 40 feet beyond the stop line, and 2. No more than 180 feet beyond the stop line unless a supplemental near-side signal face is provided." - "The primary signal faces that are used to satisfy the requirements of Item A shall simultaneously satisfy the lateral placement requirement described in Section 4D.07 (see Figure 4D-2)." - The same faces shall also fall within the 20-degree cone: "located between two lines intersecting with the center of the approach at a point 10 feet behind the stop line, one making an angle of approximately 20 degrees to the right of the center of the approach extended, and the other making an angle of approximately 20 degrees to the left of the center of the approach extended." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 4D-2 dimensions the placement area as "40 ft*" (Minimum distance of signal faces from stop line), "120 ft**" (Maximum distance from stop line for 8-inch signal face), and "180 ft***" (Maximum distance from stop line for 12-inch signal faces, unless a near-side supplemental signal face is used), all measured from a point 10 ft behind the stop line within 20°/20° lines from the center of approach. - [Image 2] Page 672 presents the same Figure 4D-2 in page context with the identical 40 ft / 120 ft / 180 ft annotations and footnotes. - [Image 3] Page 673 contains Section 4D.08, which codifies the 40-foot minimum and 180-foot maximum shown in the figure. - [Image 4] Page 671 contains Section 4D.07, establishing the lateral 20-degree cone that the same faces must simultaneously satisfy. - [Image 5] Page 668 (Section 4D.05) provides related provisions on the number of signal faces referenced in the figure's notes but does not alter the longitudinal limits. Citations: - Section 4D.08 Standard §1 (p.673) - Section 4D.07 Standard §1 (p.671) - Figure 4D-2 (p.672)
gold_answer: At least 40 feet and no more than 180 feet beyond the stop line.
